tickets.name: Scale app cluster before traffic spike
tickets.blurb: {{node_name}} is on Tier {{current_tier}} ({{current_capacity}}). Marketing has a campaign in 5 minutes that will bring 1,200 rps — above your current headroom. Tier {{target_tier}} ({{target_capacity}}) handles the load before it hits.

tickets.name: App cluster can only scale vertically — refactor for scale-out
tickets.blurb: Last month's traffic spike saturated {{node_name}} and manual vertical scaling during the incident cost 40 minutes. The cluster is configured for vertical scaling only. Refactoring it for horizontal scale-out lets you add instances instead of resizing — faster to react and cheaper under burst load.

tickets.name: Load balancer is a single-AZ bottleneck
tickets.blurb: {{node_name}} sits in a single availability zone. One AZ failure takes the entire ingress path offline — not just capacity, but total unavailability for your SLA customers. Enable multi-AZ to spread the load across zones and keep traffic flowing during an AZ event.

tickets.name: Database query latency SLA at risk
tickets.blurb: {{node_name}} query latency is approaching the p95 SLA threshold. Tier {{current_tier}} ({{current_capacity}}) is near capacity on busy days. Tier {{target_tier}} ({{target_capacity}}) doubles query throughput and adds a read replica.

tickets.name: CDN tier 1 can't absorb launch traffic
tickets.blurb: {{node_name}} at Tier {{current_tier}} ({{current_capacity}}) has 20% headroom before the product launch. The launch brings 50,000 rps. Without Tier {{target_tier}} ({{target_capacity}}), the CDN saturates and traffic hits your origin directly.

tickets.name: Cache hit rate falling — tier 1 at capacity
tickets.blurb: Cache hit rate has been falling. {{node_name}} is on Tier {{current_tier}} ({{current_capacity}}) and at 90% capacity during peak hours. Tier {{target_tier}} ({{target_capacity}}) triples throughput and reduces latency under load. The customer success team is starting to notice the slowdowns.

tickets.name: Deploy requires a hot standby
tickets.blurb: The team is deploying a schema migration this sprint. Engineering requires a hot standby on {{node_name}} before they merge — if the migration fails, you need to roll back in under 2 minutes. No replica means no deploy window.

tickets.name: On-call insists on autoscaling before deploy
tickets.blurb: The deployment team won't merge the new service until autoscaling is enabled on {{node_name}}. The last deployment caused a 45-minute incident when traffic spiked 3x and the team had to manually scale. Enable autoscaling first.

tickets.name: Backup before major schema migration
tickets.blurb: Schema migration is scheduled for next deploy window. The DBA requires a verified backup of {{node_name}} before the migration runs. If the migration corrupts data, the backup is the only recovery path.

tickets.name: SLA contract requires multi-AZ for Tier 1 customers
tickets.blurb: Your SLA contract with enterprise customers specifies 99.95% uptime. A single-AZ deployment of {{node_name}} cannot mathematically guarantee that. The enterprise renewals are next quarter. Enable multi-AZ now.

tickets.name: Disaster recovery drill: database must reach auto-failover tier
tickets.blurb: A disaster recovery drill is scheduled for next month. The scenario: primary node goes offline. SRE lead requires {{node_name}} to be at a tier with auto-failover before the drill — manual failover failed the last run, taking 8 minutes against a 2-minute RTO target. Upgrade the database until auto-failover is active.

tickets.name: Security audit: database must be encrypted at rest
tickets.blurb: Security audit is next week. Auditor checklist item 3.2: {{node_name}} must have encryption at rest enabled. Encryption arrives at Tier 3 — upgrade the database until it reaches that tier before the audit window closes.

tickets.name: DDoS protection required for PCI scope
tickets.blurb: The API is in scope for PCI DSS compliance. PCI requirement 6.4: rate limiting must be in place on all external-facing endpoints. {{node_name}} needs rate limiting enabled before the QSA audit. A failed audit item means the company cannot process card payments.

tickets.name: Regional outage plan: replicate the database to a second region
tickets.blurb: The SRE team's runbook requires {{node_name}} to replicate to a second region before you can declare multi-region readiness. A single-region database means a regional failure takes the entire product offline. Enable multi-region replication now.

tickets.name: Security team requires credential rotation before launch
tickets.blurb: The security team's pre-launch checklist includes rotating all database credentials. Shared static passwords increase blast radius if one service is compromised. Rotate {{node_name}} credentials now so each service uses a unique secret.

tickets.name: Failed jobs are being silently dropped
tickets.blurb: Failed background jobs are being silently dropped. Two customers reported missing webhook deliveries. {{node_name}} needs a DLQ configured to capture failures so they can be retried. Without it, every failed job is permanently lost.

tickets.name: TLS cert expires next sprint
tickets.blurb: {{node_name}} at Tier {{current_tier}} has stale_cert — it expires every sprint and is renewed manually. Tier {{target_tier}} switches to managed certificate rotation: auto-renewal, no more expiry risk. Upgrade {{node_name}} to Tier {{target_tier}} before the certificate window closes.

tickets.name: Analytical queries are crushing the database
tickets.blurb: The data team's nightly analytics queries compete with OLTP traffic on {{node_name}} Tier {{current_tier}} ({{current_capacity}}). Tier {{target_tier}} ({{target_capacity}}) adds a dedicated query cache and read pool that isolates the two workloads.

tickets.name: CDN single-AZ deployment is a reliability gap
tickets.blurb: {{node_name}} serves all edge traffic from a single availability zone. One AZ event takes your entire CDN layer offline and exposes origin to full traffic. Enable multi-AZ distribution on the CDN so requests are automatically rerouted when a zone goes down.

tickets.name: Black Friday traffic projection exceeds tier 3 capacity
tickets.blurb: Traffic forecasts for the peak event project load above {{node_name}}'s Tier {{current_tier}} ceiling of {{current_capacity}}. Tier {{target_tier}} ({{target_capacity}}) handles the projected peak. You have a narrow window before the platform freeze.

tickets.name: Security audit: restrict public object store access
tickets.blurb: Security audit flagged {{node_name}} as publicly accessible. Any authenticated user — or misconfigured service — can read your stored objects. Restrict access to least-privilege policies so only authorised services can read or write.

tickets.name: On-call rotation needs metrics before next week
tickets.blurb: The new on-call rotation starts Monday. The incoming SRE refused to take pager duty without observability in place. Enable monitoring on {{node_name}} so the on-call can see what's happening and get paged immediately instead of hearing from customers first.
